story: Mina held a moon atlas, and she wanted to sketch the moon. Jun said, “My whale book is missing.” Mina said, “I promise to help you.” Mina and Jun searched the window nook, but Mina did not find the whale book. Jun spotted the star bookmark on the high shelf. Mina returned the moon atlas to the display table, and she chose to help Jun. Ms Alvarez used the ladder to lift the whale book down. Ms Alvarez gave Jun the whale book. Jun said, “I can help you.” Jun opened the whale book for Mina. Mina sketched the whale from the whale book on the paper. Mina showed Jun the whale drawing.
